# TEL - Thèses en ligne (HAL Theses)

> > An open-access French PhD thesis repository operated by CCSD, providing free access to doctoral research and academic publications.

TEL (Thèses en ligne) is the primary platform for depositing and accessing French doctoral theses. It is part of HAL (Hyper Articles en Ligne), a multidisciplinary open-access archive that implements OAI-PMH protocols for scientific communication and self-archiving.

## Key Topics

- HAL Open Archive
- TEL - Thèses en ligne

## Core Platform

- [Home - TEL - Thèses en ligne](https://theses.hal.science): Main portal for accessing the French open-access PhD thesis repository operated by CCSD

## Featured Theses

- [Sur les ruptures faibles dans les modèles hétéroscédastiques non-linéaires](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05559910v1): PhD thesis by Fatma Aouissaoui on statistical testing for weak change-point detection in nonlinear heteroscedastic models
- [Le code de conduite, instrument de soumission des entreprises multinationales](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05559856v1): PhD thesis by Mary Lambard examining codes of conduct as regulatory instruments for multinational corporations
- [Travaux expérimentaux sur les détonations dans les gaz](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05559827v1): HDR thesis by Vincent Rodriguez on gaseous detonation dynamics and fluid mechanics research
- [La politique des déchets à Kinshasa](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05559790v1): PhD thesis by Joël Munongo Yula analyzing waste management policy in Kinshasa
- [Numerical and experimental study of a passive oscillating-foil](https://theses.hal.science/tel-05559789v1): PhD thesis by Siham Eddine Zantoute on hydraulic energy recovery using oscillating foil technology

## Optional

- [Search - HAL Open Archive (Latest)](https://theses.hal.science/browse/last): Search interface for browsing recently deposited theses
- [Search - HAL Open Archive (Domain)](https://theses.hal.science/browse/domain): Domain-based browsing and search functionality for theses by research field
- [Search - HAL Open Archive (Period)](https://theses.hal.science/browse/period): Period-based search interface for accessing theses by publication date
- [Search - HAL Open Archive (Collection)](https://theses.hal.science/browse/collection): Collection browsing interface for exploring theses by institutional groupings
